title: Cruz Azul Crushes León 4-0 and Toluca Takes Command in Liga MX Quarterfinal First Legs — Return Legs Set for Nov. 28-29
excerpt: Cruz Azul delivered the statement result of the Apertura 2026 quarterfinal first legs, routing León 4-0 on the road, while Toluca beat Atlas 2-0, Pachuca edged regular-season leaders Chivas 2-1, and Monterrey held América to a scoreless draw despite playing most of the match with 10 men.
content:
MEXICO CITY — The Liga MX Apertura 2026 quarterfinals are halfway decided, and Cruz Azul delivered the statement result of the first legs, routing León 4-0 on the road on Thursday night at Estadio León.

José Paradela scored twice for La Máquina, Nicolás Ibáñez added a goal, and Gabriel 'Toro' Fernández capped the rout with a spectacular half-bicycle-kick finish. Cruz Azul was the only visiting team to win in the first legs, and the four-goal cushion leaves León needing a near-miracle in the return leg on Sunday at Estadio Banorte.

On Wednesday, Toluca took a firm grip on its tie by beating Atlas 2-0 at Estadio Nemesio Diez, with Brazilian Helinho scoring both goals — the opener a left-footed strike from outside the area in the 15th minute. Atlas hosts the return leg on Saturday at Estadio Jalisco needing to overturn two goals, though a tied aggregate would still favor the Rojinegros on regular-season position.

Also on Wednesday, Monterrey and América played to a 0-0 draw at Estadio BBVA, with Rayados holding on after defender Ricardo Chávez was sent off in the 11th minute for a foul on Colombian Óscar Perea. América pressed for most of the match but could not beat goalkeeper Luis Cárdenas. The tie will be settled Saturday at Estadio Banorte, where América advances on a tied aggregate thanks to its better regular-season finish — Monterrey must win to stay alive.

On Thursday, Pachuca came from behind to beat Chivas 2-1 at Estadio Hidalgo, with Oussama Idrissi scoring both goals for the Tuzos before also being sent off. Chivas, the regular-season leaders, host the return leg on Sunday at Estadio Akron needing a win to advance.

As things stand, the projected semifinals would pair Cruz Azul against Pachuca and América against Toluca. In every tie, a level aggregate sends through the team that finished higher in the regular-season standings.

Sources: Claro Sports, Nov. 27, 2026; SoyReferee, Nov. 26, 2026; Crónica Maya, Nov. 26, 2026; Ovaciones, Nov. 26, 2026.
